spots.name: Ibergeregg – Alpthal side
spots.notes: Steep fir-beech forest on limestone (site map: 18M Karbonat-Tannen-Buchenwald), about 40 % conifers. Look on north-facing, mossy slopes and near streams. Bus Schwyz–Ibergeregg or Einsiedeln–Oberiberg.

spots.name: Oberiberg – Ybrig forests
spots.notes: Acidic spruce-fir forest with bilberry (46 Heidelbeer-Tannen-Fichtenwald), about 80 % conifers. Also good for winter chanterelles in late October. Bus from Einsiedeln.

spots.name: Unteriberg – Studen slopes
spots.notes: Spruce forest on limestone (60* Buntreitgras-Fichtenwald), almost only conifers. The Breitried reserve (no picking) is nearby: check the reserve layer on map.geo.sz.ch before picking.

spots.name: Wägital – Innerthal lake slopes
spots.notes: Fir-beech forest on calcareous soil (18v Buntreitgras-Tannen-Buchenwald mit Rostsegge), mostly broadleaf, on the slopes above the Wägitalersee. Quiet valley. Train to Siebnen, then bus.

spots.name: Sattel – Hochstuckli
spots.notes: Acidic spruce-fir forest with bilberry (46 Heidelbeer-Tannen-Fichtenwald) on moraine, about 80 % conifers. Easy access from Sattel station (gondola to Mostelberg).

spots.name: Raten – Biberegg side
spots.notes: Acidic fir-beech forest with wood-rush (19 Waldsimsen-Tannen-Buchenwald), about 80 % conifers, near the Zug border and the Rothenthurm moors: stay on the Schwyz side and out of the moor reserves.

spots.name: Ibergeregg – upper spruce
spots.notes: Conifer-rich forest (about 75 % conifers) on calcareous soil; the site map shows maple-ash forest (26w Ahorn-Eschenwald mit Buntreitgras). Just outside the Ibergeregg nature reserve. Go early in the season, before frost reaches this height.

spots.name: Hoch-Ybrig – Weglosen
spots.notes: Steep fir-beech forest on limestone (18M Karbonat-Tannen-Buchenwald), about a third conifers. The Hoch-Ybrig plant protection reserve (no picking) is close by. Bus Einsiedeln–Oberiberg–Weglosen.

spots.name: Hochstuckli – upper slopes
spots.notes: Fir-spruce forest with tall herbs (50 Hochstauden-Tannen-Fichtenwald), neutral soil, almost only conifers, above Mostelberg.

spots.name: Haggenegg – Alpthal side
spots.notes: Fir-beech forest with tall herbs (20 Hochstauden-Tannen-Buchenwald) on moraine, mixed conifers and broadleaf, below the pass. The Mythen plant protection reserve (no picking) borders it. Bus to Alpthal, then hike up.

spots.name: Rigi north – above Küssnacht
spots.notes: Beech forest (8 Waldhirsen-Buchenwald) on moraine, neutral soil, toward Seebodenalp. Frost comes later here, so this works into November.

spots.name: Rigi – above Arth-Goldau
spots.notes: Steep beech forest on calcareous soil (17 Steilhang-Buchenwald mit Buntreitgras). Direct train from Zürich to Arth-Goldau.

spots.name: Morschach forest slopes
spots.notes: Beech forest (8 Waldhirsen-Buchenwald), neutral soil, above the Urnersee. Bus from Brunnen.

spots.name: Gersau beech forests
spots.notes: Beech-lime forest on limestone (13T Bingelkraut-Buchenwald mit Linde), almost only broadleaf, on the slopes above the lake. Boat or bus from Brunnen.
